_comment: First Load JS budgets in kB, checked by `pnpm bundle:check` after `pnpm build` (CI runs it). Each entry is the size measured on 13 Oct 2026 plus about 7% headroom; routes not listed share defaultKb. If a change legitimately adds weight, raise the number in the same commit and say why in the pull request. Phase 14 added /front-desk at 218 kB measured on 14 Oct 2026 (board, tabs, sheet, walk-in form and time-zone formatting; the patient card and its dialogs load on demand, and /inbox grew by 3 kB). Phase 22K added /accounting/tally-import at 217 kB measured on 13 Oct 2026 (22I's page carries the Tally XML dry-run and upload loop; over the default on the integrated build; 22I never ran the budget check, docs/22_PHASE_22K_NOTES.md). On 14 Oct 2026 /templates was raised to 263 kB: it measured 246 kB after the named-variable, one-time-code and catalogue templates (#58) plus the ~1 kB browser loader that every route now carries for Sentry (the SDK itself loads on demand, only with a DSN). On 14 Oct 2026 /settings/users got its own budget of 231 kB: it measured 216 kB once the Phase B Branch access dialog (checkbox list and home-branch picker) joined the routing dialog. Baseline before Phase 13 and the after numbers are in docs/13_PHASE_13_NOTES.md. Phase C (14 Oct 2026) added /doctors at 250 kB (measured 233 kB) and /staff at 270 kB (measured 251 kB): both are DataGrid lists (TanStack Table and the virtualiser, like /tasks) with a record drawer; /staff also carries the tabs, duties and shift list. On 14 Oct 2026 /inbox was raised to 325 kB: it measured 315 kB, exactly its budget, after Phase F (snooze, bulk select, message search, the replying-now presence and Create task) and the Phase D shell pieces (in-app confirm dialog, empty states).
